userVisible: The module builds into one executable file that needs only Node.
A caller can discover every command and whether it reads or writes data.
Startup checks report runtime, binary checksum, database integrity and migrations.
A calendar has a time zone and working hours, changes only from the version the caller read, and its free time is reported in both UTC and local time across a daylight-saving change.
Local working hours turn into the right instants in every time zone and year, including the hour that is skipped and the hour that repeats when clocks change.
A plan for 104 tasks is proposed without storing anything: every open task is placed inside working hours, around busy time and after its prerequisites, and asking twice gives the same answer.
A separate checker finds nothing wrong with any plan the scheduler proposes, for generated tasks, calendars and busy time, and names each kind of mistake when a plan is damaged.

A plan is stored only as it was proposed and approved: a commit against an older version, with changed blocks or after a task changed is refused, a retry returns the first answer, and a copy is made only by an explicit clone that leaves its source alone.

After a plan is committed the module hands the bot the exact task updates to forward and a calendar holds proposal; once the bot reports the events it created, nothing is proposed twice, and a dropped block or a canceled plan is proposed for cancel.
check: node scripts/verify-feature.mjs flow && node --test --test-name-pattern='calendar holds' test/cli.test.ts

userVisible: The same planning question can be handed to a constraint solver as a model, and the solver's answer comes back through the same independent check before anyone sees it.
The module answers like every other module: one JSON answer per command, fixed exit codes, repeatable output, no access to the bot's private data, and analysis that never changes data.
Anyone can read and contribute to this repository: nothing in it points at a private plan or at one person's machine.
The models of plan commit and of the calendar hold lifecycle pass the model checker, and every deliberately broken copy is caught breaking the rule it was written to break.
